findings.title: Report id squats HMA-BUDGET-<name> and suppresses the measured WAIVABLE
findings.diagnosis: AddMeasuredFindings skips when the imported list has the same id; MapAuditFindings does not reserve the HMA- prefix; host test disposition_test.go:47-51 encodes it.

evidence.observation: U1/HMA-BUDGET-max_files: ADVISORY with 4 files over a 3-file budget

fix.action: Refuse imported ids with prefix HMA- in MapAuditFindings; in AddMeasuredFindings raise any same-id entry to WAIVABLE; invert host test
fix.why: Report text must not change an HMA-measured fact (§4.1, §9)

verification.expected: A1 WAIVABLE or import refused; A6 WAIVABLE

fix.tradeoffs: Reports using HMA- ids become invalid
fix.alternative: Namespace HMA findings outside the auditor id space

findings.title: Approving review clears a unit BLOCK while HMA's kernel predicate still holds
findings.diagnosis: SnapshotFindings replaces unit findings on approve; kernel facts become findings only when cited; gate then passes with no_shell still holding.

fix.action: Raise HMA-owned HMA-KERNEL-<rule> BLOCK for every holding registered rule regardless of citation; escalate approve while any holds
fix.why: BLOCK is unwaivable; human downgrade is refused, so auditor omission must not clear it
fix.alternative: Keep prior BLOCK on approve when its rule still holds

findings.title: BLOCK/WAIVABLE dispositions reach no gate
findings.diagnosis: Review->verification gate and closure credit check ignore finding dispositions except UNAUTHORIZED_DISPATCH; architecture §5.2 and lines 670-671 require unresolved BLOCK/WAIVABLE to block closure.

evidence.observation: gate() and outcomeGate() pass with unwaived U1/HMA-BUDGET-max_files WAIVABLE

fix.action: Refuse review->verification and VERIFIED_* closure while any BLOCK, or any WAIVABLE without an active ScopeFinding waiver, is in current core findings

verification.method: Run A2, then grant a waiver
verification.expected: Refused; passes after waiver; closure only VERIFIED_WITH_WAIVERS

fix.tradeoffs: Touches gate code paths shared with Gate C/D4 tests

findings.title: evidence_current registered contrary to handoff and fires on routine repair
findings.diagnosis: KernelRules includes evidence_current; predicate uses the latest credit from any earlier implementation; stale credit is already void (D5a), so this is not a kernel violation.

evidence.observation: U1/E1: BLOCK after credit, re-implementation, repair commit

fix.why: Matches the handoff and §4.1 (stale evidence is not credited, not a blocker)
fix.alternative: Restrict predicate to the current implementation's credit

findings.title: no_shell predicate holds for non-shell, environment-dependent reasons
findings.diagnosis: unsafeLoopArgv returns true on LookPath failure and for network/publication tools.

fix.action: Use evidence.RejectShell for no_shell; refuse import on resolution failure; register external_effect separately if wanted
fix.why: Rule name must match the §7.1 rule it reproduces
fix.tradeoffs: Fewer BLOCKs for curl/ssh plans unless a new rule is added

findings.title: Repository attributes and config hide lines from the budget measurement
findings.diagnosis: git diff --numstat honours -diff/binary attributes and core.bigFileThreshold; binary rows count zero lines.

evidence.observation: 500 lines over 100 budget: ADVISORY with '* -diff', WAIVABLE without

fix.action: Add --text and neutralise attributes/bigFileThreshold for the numstat call
fix.why: Measurement must not be steerable by worker-controlled content

findings.title: Dirty content of a dirty-approved review target is not measured
findings.diagnosis: Measurement is base..HEAD only; disclosed in handoff.

fix.action: When WorktreeDigest is set, diff base against the worktree and include untracked paths
fix.why: Budget must cover the reviewed artifact
fix.alternative: Refuse findings import for dirty targets

findings.title: Stale comment, run-wide authority, plan-less runs cannot import findings, rename/merge/submodule counting undocumented
findings.diagnosis: review_import.go:85-87 comment stale; authority not unit-scoped; currentPlanUnit refuses runs without a lease plan.

fix.action: Update comment; document counting and the plan requirement; consider unit-scoping authority

limitations: Same vendor family as implementer (Claude Sonnet 5.5 vs auditor Claude Opus 5.5); fresh context only
authority BLOCK not run end to end
Renames, merges and submodules assessed by code reading
D5b handoff read after PHASE1.json and controls A1-A7; it prompted A8
